name: blog-create
description: A blog creation skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to create and publish a new blog under a specified site language and blog group, with support for publisher, publication date, cover image, tags, summary, and HTML description.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to publish into, such as `en` or `fr`. Do not guess or translate it. First call `languages-get`, show the language list to the user, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

blog.description: Required. Complete blog payload for a new blog. Treat this as the blog that will actually be published.

bloggroup_id.description: Required. Blog group ID for the new blog. First call `bloggroup-read`, then copy one exact `bloggroup_id`.

publisher.description: Optional. Publisher name, up to 100 characters.

publication_date.description: Optional. Display publication date in `yyyy/M/d` format, for example `2026/4/24`. If omitted, the server uses the current date.

title.description: Required. Blog title shown to users, up to 500 characters.

cover_image.description: Required. Cover image payload. It must be one {name, base64} object with a valid image not larger than 500 kB.

name.description: Image file label used to identify this image inside the payload.

base64.description: Base64 image data with MIME prefix, for example `image/jpeg;base64,...`.

tags.description: Required. Provide 1 to 6 search keyword tags. Each tag must contain 3 to 50 characters.

summary.description: Required. Blog summary as plain text, up to 500 characters.

description.description:

seo.description: Optional. SEO metadata for search engines.

title.description: Optional. Optimized title, up to 90 characters.

description.description: Optional. Optimized description, up to 200 characters.

keywords.description: Optional. SEO keywords as one comma-separated string, with up to 6 keywords and total length 120 characters or fewer.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact blog creation request after seeing the final language and payload.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact blog payload to be created. Never set this to `true` based on assumption.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language and exact blog payload shown to the user before execution.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.

url.description: Preview URL for the created blog. Always return this to the user and ask the user to preview it.

blog.bloggroup_id.description: Select a blog group ID from `bloggroup-read` under the same language.
